name: Denver
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Denver for 2026, and here is what he found: 45 family events, 11 of them free. The magic runs from November 20 (Denver Christkindlmarket) through January 24, 2027 (Light the Lights at the Denver City and County Building), with the 9NEWS Parade of Lights (December 5), Zoo Lights (through January 3) and Magical Winter Nights at the Denver Museum of Nature & Science (November 26 to January 2) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Denver

  • 45 Christmas events for kids in Denver
  • 11 free events, including the Denver Christkindlmarket, The Mile High Tree and the 9NEWS Parade of Lights
  • Meet Santa: Photos with Santa Dinger at McGregor Square, Santa at the Station and Santa's Factory at Little Man Ice Cream
  • Parades and tree lightings: 9NEWS Parade of Lights (December 5), McGregor Skate Grand Opening & Holiday Tree Lighting (November 27) and Grand Illumination at Denver Union Station (November 27)
  • Lights: Zoo Lights, Blossoms of Light and Magical Winter Nights at the Denver Museum of Nature & Science
  • Season: November 20, 2026 to January 24, 2027

Heading out of the city? Denver families also use our guides to Christmas activities for kids in Aurora, Littleton and Golden.
